providers.reason: Brazil's first-round election surprise (Bolsonaro ~47%) sparked a ~20% weekly rally to $16.12, analysts raised targets to $23, and the Monzo acquisition overhang was removed by management denial. Strong catalyst-driven momentum with a market-friendly runoff narrative still in play.
providers.risk: Up ~20% in a single week leaves the stock extended; with the Oct 25 runoff still two weeks away, near-term consolidation or profit-taking is likely before the next catalyst.
